Our goal is to turn complex data into clear insights that help people understand how our planet is changing.

details:
🌍 Earth Science Research & Discovery Platform

Project Summary

1. Project Overview

The Earth Science Research & Discovery Platform is an advanced scientific research web application designed to automatically collect, analyze, and investigate global environmental and Earth system changes using satellite data and scientific datasets from multiple international organizations.

The main goal is not just to monitor Earth but to discover hidden environmental problems, investigate their causes, predict future changes, and generate scientific findings and recommendations.

2. Main Architecture (7 Engines)

User Interface Engine – Research Dashboard and Research Configuration.

Research Engine – Controls and manages the entire research workflow.

Data Acquisition Engine – Automatically discovers and collects scientific datasets.

Data Management Engine – Stores, validates, preprocesses, and integrates collected data.

Scientific Analysis Engine – Analyzes historical changes, trends, and anomalies.

Scientific Intelligence Engine – Investigates causes, validates findings, assesses risks, and predicts future changes.

Result Engine – Generates scientific reports, maps, graphs, alerts, and recommendations.

3. Data Sources

The platform will use multiple satellite missions and scientific organizations.

Optical Satellite Data

Sentinel-2

Landsat

MODIS

SAR / Radar Data

Sentinel-1

ALOS-2

NISAR

Weather & Climate Data

GPM

GOES

JPSS

Water & Ocean Data

SWOT

SMAP

Sentinel-3

Scientific Organizations

NASA

NOAA

ESA

FAO

USGS

Copernicus

4. Main Research Capabilities

The platform will investigate:

Forest Cover Changes

Global Temperature Changes

Rainfall Changes

Glacier and Himalayan Changes

Water Scarcity

Sea Level Changes

Environmental Disasters

Land Cover Changes

Ocean and Climate Changes

5. Research Workflow

The complete research process follows these stages:

Data Discovery – Find relevant scientific datasets automatically.

Data Collection – Download data from multiple sources.

Data Validation – Check data quality and reliability.

Data Processing – Clean and preprocess collected data.

Data Integration – Combine multiple datasets.

Change Detection – Identify environmental changes.

Trend Analysis – Analyze historical increases and decreases.

Anomaly Detection – Identify unusual environmental patterns.

Cause Investigation – Investigate possible reasons behind changes.

Risk Assessment – Evaluate environmental risks.

Prediction & Recommendations – Forecast future conditions and suggest possible actions.

6. Final Research Output

Every completed research process should generate:

Interactive Research Map

Historical Data Graphs

Scientific Findings

Environmental Change Reports

Risk Assessment Reports

Future Predictions

Recommendations

Data Sources and References

Confidence and Uncertainty Information

7. Main Objective

The platform aims to transform raw satellite and scientific data into meaningful scientific discoveries.

Observe → Collect → Analyze → Discover → Investigate → Validate → Predict → Recommend

Final Vision

Build a global scientific research platform that can automatically discover environmental changes, identify hidden problems, investigate their possible causes, understand their impacts, and predict what may happen in the future.

It is not simply a satellite monitoring website. It is a complete Earth Science Research & Discovery System.
